{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the value counts of `converted`
print(df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts of `customer_age` to confirm -1 is missing
print('\nValue counts of customer_age:')
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check if there are any rows where converted == 1 and customer_age == -1
print('\nRows where converted == 1 and customer_age == -1:')
print(df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] == -1)].shape[0])"}
